maddeler.e: فِرْقَة الْإِطْفَاء • (firqat al-ʔiṭfāʔ) f (plural فِرَق الْإِطْفَاء (firaq al-ʔiṭfāʔ))
maddeler.t: Literally, "company of the extinguishing", from فِرْقَة (firqa, “company, band, group, unit, division, etc.”) + الْإِطْفَاء (al-ʔiṭfāʔ, “the extinguishing”).
s: فِرْقَة (firqa, “company, band, group, unit, division, etc.”) + الْإِطْفَاء (al-ʔiṭfāʔ, “the extinguishing”)
